indicators: Inputs (source declarations): rsiLength=input(14,title="RSI Length", minval=1, maxval=50); buyLine=input(70,title="RSI Buy Line", minval=30, maxval=100); exitLine=input(90,title="RSI Exit Line", minval=0, maxval=100); riskCapital = input(title="Risk % of capital", defval=10, minval=1); stopLoss=input(5,title="Stop Loss",minval=1); partialExit=input(true,title="Allow Partial exit / take profits") | Indicator calls: rsi(vwap,rsiLength); ema(close,200)
exit: Source rule: (partialExit equals true); order: strategy.close(id="LE",comment="TP points="+tostring(close - strategy.position_avg_price, "####.##"),qty=strategy.position_size/3, when=crossover(vwapRsi,99) )
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Third-party Pine source; verify execution timing, pyramiding, and broker-emulator semantics before implementation.
